definition: An assessment of climate or disaster risk to particular sites, facilities or assets the project finances or uses. Does not include assessments along routes, across whole networks, or across a sector.
An assessment of hazards along the route of a cable, road, line or other linear infrastructure. Does not include assessments of single sites or whole networks.
An assessment of climate risk across an interconnected network or system (a national backbone, a utility's network). Does not include single sites or routes, or a whole sector.
An assessment of climate risk across a sector, a country's infrastructure or a portfolio of investments. Does not include assessments of one network, route or site, or hazard mapping.

Producing maps or spatial layers of climate hazards, exposure or climate hotspots to identify areas at risk or to place project activities. Choose this whenever the deliverable is a map, whatever its scale.

Technical studies that model or measure a hazard (hydrological or flood modelling, geotechnical or landslide investigations) to inform feasibility or design. Choose this whenever the deliverable is a technical hazard study rather than a risk assessment or a map.

An assessment of climate and disaster risk to the continuity of a service, institution or government function (business continuity or crisis risk analysis). Does not include assessments of physical sites, routes or networks.
Assesses climate risk affecting a defined infrastructure asset
Requires an operator, consultant, contractor or bidder to undertake the assessment

type_name: Assessment required of contractors or operators
definition: A requirement that contractors, bidders, operators or consultants carry out a climate or disaster risk assessment, written into tender documents, terms of reference, specifications or service agreements.

type_name: Hazard mapping and screening to choose sites
definition: Hazard, exposure or risk mapping, or a climate screening of candidate locations, used to decide where infrastructure goes or which areas the project targets.
